spans.s: उप ind. As a prefix to verbal and nominal themes, it expresses- (1) power, ability, (e.g. उपकरोति); (2) pervasion, (e.g. उपकीर्ण); (3) advice, instruction, (e.g. उपदिशति); (4) death, (e.g. उपरत); (5) flaw, fault, defect, (e.g. उपघात); (6) giving, (e.g. उपहरति); (7) beginning, commencement, (e.g. उपक्रमते); (8) study, (e.g. उपाध्याय); (9) reverence, (e.g. उपचरितः पिता पुत्रेण).As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns, it implies inferiority, e.g. उपगुरुः ‘an assistant master,’ उपाध्यक्ष ‘a vice-president,’ उपपति ‘a secondary husband,’ i.e. a paramour.As forming Avyay. compounds with nouns, it has the sense of ‘direction towards, nearness, contiguity’ (in space, number or time), e.g. उपकूपम्, उपपरिसरम्. In composition with numerals, उप forms संख्याबहुव्रीहि and means ‘nearly,’ ‘almost,’ e.g. उपत्रिंशाः ‘nearly thirty.’As a separable preposition, it is used with a noun in the acc. if it means ‘inferiority,’ (e.g. उप हरिं सुराः) and with a noun in the loc. if it means ‘superiority’ or ‘addition,’ (e.g. उप परार्धे हरेर्गुणाः).

उपकार्या f. 1. A royal tent, R.v.41, xi.93, xiii.79, xvi.55, 73; 2. a palace, R.v.63.
उपकुंचिका f. Small cardamoms.
उपकुम्भ a. (f. भा) 1. Near, proximate; 2. solitary, retired.
उपकुम्भ a. (f. भा) 1. Near, proximate; 2. solitary, retired.

उपकुल्या f. A canal, a ditch.
उपकूपजलाशय m. A trough near a well for watering cattle.
उपकृति f. Aid, assistance, favour.

उपक्रिया f. Service, favour.

उपक्षेपण n. 1. Throwing down, casting down; 2. accusing.

उपागम m. 1. Approach, arrival; 2. occurrence; 3. agreement.

उपगिरि (II) m. Name of a northern country situated near a mountain.
उपगु m. A cowherd.
उपगुरु m. An assistant teacher.
उपगूढ n. An embrace, उपगूढानि सवेपधूनि च K.S.iv.17, विश्रमार्थमुपगूढमजस्रम् Sis.x.88.
उपगूहन n. 1. Hiding, concealing; 2. embrace; 3. astonishment, surprise.
उपग्रह m. 1. Confinement; 2. a prisoner; 3. favour, encouragement; 4. joining, annexing; 5. a minor planet, (e.g. राहु, केतु).
उपग्राह m. 1. Making a present; 2. a present.
उपग्रहण n. 1. Seizing from below, taking hold of, स्फुरति रभसात् पाणिः पादोपसंग्रहाणाय च Mv.ii.; 2. capture; 3. holy study, वेदोपग्रहणार्थाय तावग्राहयत प्रभुः Ram.
उपाग्रहण n. Reading the Veda after initiation.
उपग्राह्य m. 1. A present; 2. an offering to a king or great man, M.ii.179, Yaj.ii.256.
उपघात m. 1. Damage, insult, injury; 2. destruction; 3. touch, contact; 4. assault; 5. disease; 6. sin.
उपघोषण n. Proclaiming, publication.
उपघ्न m. 1. Contiguous support, छेदादिवोपघ्नतरोर्व्रतत्यौ R.xiv.1; 2. shelter, protection.
उपचक्र m. A variety of the ruddy goose.
उपचक्षुस् n. An eyeglass.
उपचतुर a. (pl.) Almost four, nearly four, i.e. three or five.
उपचय m. 1. Accumulation, increase, addition, स्वशक्त्युपचये केचित् परस्य व्यसने परे यानमाहुः Sis.ii.37, ix.29; 2. quantity, heap; 3. elevation.
उपचाय्य m. A kind of sacred fire.
उपचर m. 1. Approach; 2. cure.

उपचार m. 1. Attendance, service, worshipping; 2. courtesy, compliment, politeness, polite behaviour, उपचारपदं न चेदिदम् K.S.iv.9, उपचारविधिर्मनस्विनीनाम् Mal.iii.; 3. practice, performance, M.i.111, x.32; 4. a ceremony, a religious performance, प्रयुक्तपाणिग्रहणोपचारौ K.S.vii.86; 5. an appendage, an article of decoration or furniture, R.vi.1, vii.4, K.S.vii.88; 6. customary obeisance, homage, गुरुपरितापानि न ते गात्राण्युपचारमर्हंति Sak.iii., R.iii.11; 7. a mode of address, रामभद्र इत्येव मां प्रत्युपचारः शोभते तातपरिजनस्य Ut.i.; 8. an article of worship (they are variously described); 9. conduct, behaviour, वश्यशुद्रोपचारं च M.i.116; 10. application of cure, practice of medicine; 11. a present, a bribe; 12. a pretext; 13. a request, a solicitation; 14. secondary application or figurative use of a word, (the same as लक्षणा q.v.), मुख्येप्युपचार एव शरणं स्यात् K.Pr.x.; 15. identification based on similarity (in rhetoric), उभयरूपा चेयं शुद्धा उपचोरणामिश्रितत्वात् K.Pr.ii.; 16. the occurrence of स् and ष् in the place of visarga (in gram.)

उपजीवन n. 1. Means of living; 2. property as a means of living, M.ix.207; 3. living, subsistence, निंदितार्थोपजीवनम् Yaj.iii.286.

उपजीविन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Living on, subsisting on, जातिमात्रोपजीविनाम् M.xii.114, जातिमात्रोपजीवी वा कामं स्याद् ब्राह्मणब्रुवः viii.20, नानापण्योपजीविनः ix.257.
उपजीव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) 1. Affording a livelihood, patronizing; 2. affording materials for writing, उपजीव्यग्रंथविरोधश्च R.G. or सर्वेषां कविमुख्यानामुपजीव्यो भविष्यति Bh.
उपजीव्य (II) m. 1. A patron; 2. a source, an authority, इत्यलमुपजीव्यानां मान्यानां व्याख्यानेषु कटाक्षनिक्षेपेण S.D.ii.
उपजीव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) 1. Affording a livelihood, patronizing; 2. affording materials for writing, उपजीव्यग्रंथविरोधश्च R.G. or सर्वेषां कविमुख्यानामुपजीव्यो भविष्यति Bh.
उपजोष m. 1. Affection; 2. enjoyment.
उपजोषण n. 1. Affection; 2. enjoyment.

उपज्ञा f. 1. Knowledge obtained by oneself and not handed down by tradition, invention, पाणिन्युपज्ञं व्याकरणम् S.K., प्राचेतसोपज्ञं रामायणम् R.xv.63; 2. commencement of a thing not previously done, लोकेऽभूद्यदुपज्ञमेव विदुषां सौजन्यजन्यं यशः Mall.
उपढौकन n. A respectful offering or present.
उपताप m. 1. Heat, warmth; 2. pain, sorrow, e.g. विवक्षितं ह्यनुक्तमुपतापम् (v.l. for अनुतापम्) जनयति; 3. sickness, disease; 4. haste, hurry.
उपतापन n. 1. Heating; 2. distressing.
उपतिष्य n. 1. The lunar asterism called अश्लेषा; 2. another lunar asterism, otherwise called पुनर्वसु.
उपत्यका f. Land at the foot of a hill or mountain, मलयाद्रेरुपत्यकाः R.ii.46, कांतातरेयं गंधपाषाणवत्युपत्यका D.K.
उपदंश m. 1. Anything which excites thirst or appetite अग्रमांसोपदंशं पिब नवशोणितासवम् Ve.iii.; 2. biting, stinging; 3. the venereal disease.
उपदर्शक m. 1. One who shows the way, a guide; 2. a door-keeper; 3. a witness.
उपदश a. (pl.) Almost ten, nearly ten, i.e. nine or eleven.
उपदा f. A present, an offering to a king or a great man, उपदा विविशुः शश्वत्रोत्सेकाः कोसलेश्वरम् R.iv.70, v.41, vii.30.
उपदान n. 1. An oblation, a present; 2. a gift for procuring favour or protection, a bribe.

उपादान n. 1. Taking, receiving, acquiring, विस्रब्धं ब्राह्मणः शूद्राद्द्रव्योपार्जनमाचरेत् M.viii.417; 2. conveying some sense in addition to that actually expressed, स्वसिद्धये पराक्षेपः … उपादानम् K.Pr.ii.; 3. withdrawing the organs of sense from the outer world; 4. the material out of which anything is formed, a material cause, निमित्तमेव ब्रह्म स्यादुपादानं च वेक्षणात् Adhikaraṇaratnamālā, Sank.
; 5. mention, enumeration; 6. a cause, a motive.
उपदान n. 1. An oblation, a present; 2. a gift for procuring favour or protection, a bribe.
उपदिश् f. An intermediate quarter (they are four- ऐशानी, आग्नेयी, नैरृती and वायवी).
उपदिश् f. An intermediate quarter (they are four- ऐशानी, आग्नेयी, नैरृती and वायवी).

, R.xii.57; 2. specification; 3. plea, pretext; 4. initiation, communication of a mantra. (चंद्रसूर्यग्रहे तीर्थे सिद्धक्षेत्रे शिवालये । मंत्रमात्रप्रकथनमुपदेशः स उच्यते.)

उपदेशन n. Advising, instructing.
उपदेष्टृ m. A teacher, a preceptor, a spiritual adviser, चत्वारो वयमृत्विजः स भगवान् कर्मोपदेष्टा हरिः Ve.i.
उपदेह m. 1. A cover; 2. an ointment.
उपदोह m. 1. A nipple of the udder of a cow; 2. a milking vessel.

उपद्रव m. 1. An unhappy accident, misfortune, calamity; 2. injury, trouble, पुंसामसमर्थानामुपद्रवायात्मनो भवेत्कोपः Panch.i.; 3. outrage, violence; 4. national distress; 5. rebellion; 6. a symptom, a supervenient disease (in medicine).

Bringing near; 2. attaining, gaining; 3. investiture with the sacred thread (गृह्योक्तकर्मणा येन समीपं नीयते गुरोः । बालो वेदाय तद्योगाद् बालस्योपानयं विदुः); 4. the fourth member of the five-fold syllogism (in logic); (it is thus defined- व्याप्तिविशिष्टस्य हेतोः पक्षधर्मताप्रतिपादकं वचनमुपनयः.)
उपनाय n. The same as उपनयन q.v.
उपनयन n. 1. Leading to or near; 2. investiture with the sacred thread, आसमावर्तनात्कुर्यात् कृतोपनयनो द्विजः M.ii.108, 173.
उपनायन n. The same as उपनयन q.v., गर्भाष्टमेऽब्दे कुर्वीत ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनम् M.ii.36.

उपनागरिका f. A kind of वृत्त्यनुप्रास. It is formed by sweet-sounding (माधुर्यव्यंजक) letters. The K.Pr. quotes the following āryā from the Kuṭṭinīmata as an example- अपसारय घनसारं कुरु हारं दूर एव किं कमलैः । अलमलमालि मृणालैरिति वदति दिवानिशं बाला.
उपनायक m. 1. A paramour; 2. a character in a work of art next in importance to the hero, (e.g. मकरंद in the M.M.)
उपनायिका f. A character in a work of art next in importance to the heroine.
उपनाह m. 1. A bundle; 2. an unguent applied to a wound or sore; 3. a peg to which the strings of a lyre are attached and by which they are tightened.
उपानह f. (nom. sing. ˚नत्) A shoe, e.g. उपानद्गूढपादस्य सर्वा चर्मवृत्तेव M.ii.178, 246, iii.238.
उपनाहन n. Applying an unguent, anointing, plastering.

उपनिक्षेप m. 1. The act of depositing; 2. an open deposit, any article entrusted to one’s keeping, letting him know what it is. (उपनिक्षेपो नाम रूपसंख्याप्रदर्शनेन रक्षणार्थं परस्य हस्ते निहितं द्रव्यम् Mit. on Yaj.ii.25.)
उपनिधान n. 1. Placing near; 2. depositing; 3. a deposit.

उपनिधि m. 1. A deposit in general; 2. a sealed deposit (यदप्रदर्शितरूपं सचिह्नवस्त्रादिना पिहितं निक्षिप्यते Medhātithi on M.viii.149), Yaj.ii.25, M.viii.145; 3. pledge, property under the care of a creditor.
उपनिपात m. 1. Approaching, coming near; 2. sudden and unexpected attack or occurrence, रंध्रोपनिपातिनोऽनर्था
इति यदुच्यते
तदव्यभिचारि वचः Sak.vi.
उपनिमंत्रण n. Invitation, inauguration.
उपनिवेशित a. (f. ता) 1. Placed, established, colonized, R.xv.27.
उपनिवेशित a. (f. ता) 1. Placed, established, colonized, R.xv.27.

उपनिषद f. 1. Certain mystical writings attached to the Brāhmaṇas (n.), the aim of which is the ascertainment of the secret sense of the Veda, यद्वेदाध्ययनं तथोपनिषदां योगस्य सांख्यस्य च ज्ञानम् M.M.i., उपनिषदः परिप्रीता गीतापि च हंत मतिपथं नीता Bh.V.ii.40 (the word is variously derived- (1) उपनीय तमात्मानं ब्रह्मापास्तद्वयं यतः । निहंत्यविद्यां तज्जं च तस्मादुपनिषद्भवेत्, (2) निहत्यानर्थमूलं स्वविद्यां प्रत्यक्तया परम् । नयत्यपास्तसंभेदमतो वोपनिषद्भवेत्, (3) प्रवृत्तिहेतून्निःशेषांस्तन्मूलोच्छेदकत्वतः । यतोऽवसादयेद्विद्या तस्मादुपनिषद्भवेत्; in the मुक्तकोपनिषद् 108 Upanishads are mentioned; but additions have been made even to this number); 2. true knowledge, knowledge regarding Brahman (n.); 3. sacred or religious lore; 4. secrecy, seclusion.
उपनिष्कर n. A street, a principal road.
उपनिष्क्रमण n. 1. Going out; 2. the religious rite of taking a child for the first time into the open air (generally performed in the fourth month of its age); 3. a main road.
उपनृत्य n. A place for dancing.
उपनेतृ (I) a. (f. त्री) One who brings or comes, K.S.i.60.
उपनेतृ (II) m. A preceptor who performs the उपनयन ceremony.
उपनेतृ (I) a. (f. त्री) One who brings or comes, K.S.i.60.
उपन्यास m. 1. Juxtaposition; 2. statement, proposal, निर्यातः शनकैरलीकवचनोपन्यासमालीजनः Am.
; 3. suggestion, hint, अवसरे खलु रागोपकारयोर्गरीयसोरुपन्यासः M.M.vi.
उपपति m. A paramour, उपपतिरिव नीचेः पश्चिमांतेन चंद्रः Sis.xi.65, M.iii.155, iv.216, 217.

उपपत्ति f. 1. Appearance, production; 2. cause, reason; 3. reasoning (उपपत्तिमत् ‘well-reasoned’ Kir.ii.1); 4. fitness, propriety; 5. ascertainment, demonstration, an ascertained or demonstrated conclusion, उपपत्तिरुदाहृता बलात् Kir.ii.28; 6. a means, an expedient; 7. accomplishment, non-failure, स्वार्थोपपतिं प्रति दुर्बलाशः R.v.12, तात्पर्यानुपपतितः Bh.P.; 8. attainment, acquirement, R.xiv.78.
उपपद n. 1. A word next preceding, a word prefixed or previously uttered, तस्याः स राजोपपदं निशांतम् R.xvi.40; 2. a title, a degree, (e.g. शर्मन्, वर्मन्); 3. a secondary word of a sentence.
उपपन्न a. (f. न्ना) Fit, proper (generally with the gen. or loc.) उपपन्नमिदं विशेषणं वायोः Vikr.ii., उपपन्नमेतदृषिकल्पेस्मिन्राजनि Sak.ii.)
उपपन्न a. (f. न्ना) Fit, proper (generally with the gen. or loc.) उपपन्नमिदं विशेषणं वायोः Vikr.ii., उपपन्नमेतदृषिकल्पेस्मिन्राजनि Sak.ii.)
उपपरीक्षण n. Investigation, examination.
उपपरीक्षा f. Investigation, examination.
उपपात m. 1. Unexpected occurrence; 2. accident, misfortune.
उपपातक n. A crime or sin in the second degree. (महापातकतुल्यानि पापान्युक्तानि यानि तु । तानि पातकसंज्ञानि तन्न्यूनमुपपातकम् Paiṭhinasi), Yaj.ii.210.
उपपादन n. 1. Effecting, doing; 2. giving, delivering; 3. proving, establishing by argument, demonstration.
उपपाप n. The same as उपपातक q.v.
उपपार्श्व m.n. 1. A shoulder; 2. flank; 3. the opposite side.
उपपीडन n. 1. Pressing down, devastating; 2. inflicting pain, व्याधिभिश्चोपपीडनम् M.vi.62; 3. agony, torture.
उपपुर n. A suburb.

उपपुराण m. A secondary or minor Purāṇa. (They are thus enumerated by हेमाद्रि- आद्यं सनत्कुमारोक्तं नारसिंहमतःपरम् । तृतीयं नारदप्रोक्तं कुमारेण तु भावितम् । चतुर्थं शिवधर्माख्यं साक्षान्नंदीशभाषितम् । दुर्वाससोक्तमाश्चर्यं नारदोक्तमतःपरम् । कापिलं मानवं चैव तथैवोशनसेरितम् । ब्रह्मांडं वारुणं तथा शांबं सौरं सर्वार्थसंचयम् । पराशरोक्तमवरं तथा भागवताह्वयम्).
उपपुष्पिका f. Yawning, gaping.
उपप्रदर्शन n. Pointing out, indication.
उपप्रदान n. 1. Delivering over; 2. a present, a bribe; 3. a tribute, e.g. तस्योपप्रदानेन संधिरेव युक्तः.
उपप्रलोभन n. 1. Seducing, alluring; 2. a bribe, an allurement, an inducement, उच्चावचान्युपप्रलोभनानि D.K.
उपप्रेक्षण n. Overlooking, disregarding.
उपप्रैष m. Invitation, summons.

उपप्लव m. 1. Unlucky accident, injury, trouble, क्वचिन्न वाय्वादिरुपपप्लवो वः R.v.6, Megh.i.17, उपप्लवाय लोकानां धूमकेतुरिवोत्थितः K.S.ii.32; 2. a calamity, a danger, R.ii.48; 3. fear, नृपा इवोपप्लविनः R.xiii.7; 4. distress, difficulty, adversity, अथ मदनवधूरुपप्लवान्तं व्यसनकृशा परिपालयां बभूव K.S.iv.46; 5. a portent, a natural phenomenon foreboding evil; 6. anarchy; 7. an eclipse of the sun or the moon; 8. a name of Rāhu.
उपबंध m. 1. Connection; 2. an affix.; 3. a particular mode of sexual enjoyment.
उपब(व)र्ह m. A pillow.
उपब(व)र्ह m. A pillow.
उपबहु a. A few, a tolerable number.
उपबाहु m. The lower arm.
उपभंग m. 1. Fleeing away, retreat; 2. division.
उपभाषा f. A secondary dialect.
उपभुक्ति f. The same as उपभोग q.v.
उपभृत् f. A round cup used in sacrifices.
उपभोग m. 1. Use, practice, enjoyment, न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति M.ii.94; 2. usufruct; 3. pleasure, satisfaction; 4. cohabitation, R.xiv.24.
उपम a. (f. मा) Like, resembling (as the last member of compounds).
उपम a. (f. मा) Like, resembling (as the last member of compounds).

उपमा f. 1. Resemblance, equality, similarity, स्फुटोपमं भूतिसितेन शंभुना Sis.i.4; 2. a figure of speech (in rhetoric), corresponding to the English simile, e.g. उपमा कालिदासस्य; it is thus defined by Jagannātha- सादृश्यं सुंदरं वाक्यार्थोपस्कारकमुपमालंकृतिः R.G.; Jayadeva defines and illustrates it thus- उपमा यत्र सादृश्यलक्ष्मीरुल्लसति स्वयोः । हंसीव कृष्ण ते कीर्तिः स्वर्गंगामवगाहते Chandrāloka.v.; 3. the standard of comparison, (the same as उपमान), बुबुधे न बुधोपमः R.i.47, सर्वोपमाद्रव्यसमुच्चयेन K.S.i.50, यथा वातो निवातस्यो नेंगते सोपमा स्मृता Bg.vi.19 (where Śankara explains उपमा by उपमीयते अनेन); 4. a likeness (as a picture &c.).
उपमंत्रण n. 1. The act of addressing or inviting; 2. of persuading, (उपमंत्रणमुपच्छंदनम् S.K.)
उपमंथनी f. A staff for stirring fire (in ritualistic works).
उपमर्द m. 1. Friction, rubbing down, e.g. अन्यासु तावदुपमर्दसहासु भृंग लोलं विनोदय मनः सुमनोलतासु; 2. injuring, killing, destruction; 3. unhusking; 4. reproach, abuse; 5. refutation of a charge.
उपमा-द्रव्य n. any object used for comparison, K.S.i.50.
उपमातृ f. 1. A wet nurse; 2. a near female relative (they are- मातृष्वसा मातुलानी पितृव्यस्त्री पितृष्वसा । श्वश्रूः पूर्वजपत्नी च मातृतुल्याः प्रकीर्तिताः Bṛhaspati.)

उपमान n. 1. Comparison, K.S.i.36; 2. analogy, considered as one of the four kinds of proof by the Naiyāyikas; it is defined as being प्रसिद्धसाधर्म्यात् साध्यसाधनम्; 3. the standard of comparison, that with which anything is compared, (op. to उपमेय); (as such it is one of the four requisites of उपमा), K.S.iv.5, उपमानमभूद्विलासिनीनाम् K.S.iv.5, उपमानस्यापि सखे प्रत्युपमानं वपुस्तस्याः Vikr.ii.

उपमिति f. 1. Resemblance, comparison, similarity, तदाननस्योपमितौ दरिद्रता Na.i.24; 2. knowledge of things derived from analogy, a conclusion arrived at by (in Nyāya phil.) प्रत्यक्षमप्यनुमितिस्तथोपमितिशब्दजे Bh.P.; 3. a figure of speech, more generally known as उपमा q.v.
उपमेय (I) a. (f. या) Fit to be likened, fit to be compared, आसीदुपमेयकांतिर्मयूरपृष्ठाश्रयिणा गुहेन R.vi.4, xviii.34, 37.
उपमेय (II) n. The object of comparison (in rhetoric), उपमानोपमेययोरेव न कार्यकारणादिकयोः साधर्म्यं भवति K.Pr.x.
उपमेय (I) a. (f. या) Fit to be likened, fit to be compared, आसीदुपमेयकांतिर्मयूरपृष्ठाश्रयिणा गुहेन R.vi.4, xviii.34, 37.

उपमेय-उपमा f. a figure of speech consisting in the mutual comparison of the उपमान and the उपमेय, which raises an implication that the like of them does not exist. (Cf. अनन्वय); for instances, See K.Pr.x., S.D.x.
उपयंतृ m. A bride-groom, a husband, R.viii.1, K.S.v.45.
उपयंत्र n. A minor surgical instrument.
उपय(या)म m. 1. Marriage, e.g. कन्या त्वजातोपयमा सलज्जा नवयौवना; 2. restraint.
उपय(या)म m. 1. Marriage, e.g. कन्या त्वजातोपयमा सलज्जा नवयौवना; 2. restraint.
उपयमन n. 1. Marrying, taking a wife; 2. restraining, curbing.
उपयष्टृ m. One of the sixteen priests at a sacrifice.
उपयाचक a. (f. का) An asker, a solicitor, a suitor, a beggar.
उपयाचक a. (f. का) An asker, a solicitor, a suitor, a beggar.
उपयाचन n. Soliciting, approaching with a request or prayer.

उपयाचित n. 1. A request, a prayer; 2. a prayer or request to a deity for the fulfilment of a desire, ग्रहाणां चरितं स्वप्नो निमित्तात्युपयाचितम् । फलंति काकतालीयं तेभ्यः प्राज्ञा न बिभ्यति Ve.ii.; 3. a present promised to a deity on the fulfilment of a request made; the present generally consisted of an animal, sometimes of a human being. See M.M.v. (अद्य मया भगवत्याः करालायाः प्रागुपयाचितं स्त्रीरत्नमुपहर्तव्यम्.) उपयाचितक also is used in this sense.
उपयाज m. Additional formulæ at a sacrifice.
उपयान n. Approaching, coming near, K.S.vii.22.
उपायन n. 1. Going near to; 2. becoming a pupil; 3. a gift or present, तस्योपायनयोग्यानि वस्तूनि सरितां पतिः K.S.ii.37, R.iv.79.
उपयोग m. 1. Application, employment, use, utility, अनंगलेखक्रिययोपयोगम् K.S.i.7; 2. administration of medicine; 3. fitness, suitableness; 4. contact, proximity.
उपरक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Eclipsed; 2. afflicted, overtaken by calamity; 3. tinged, coloured.
उपरक्त (II) m. The sun or the moon in eclipse.
उपरक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Eclipsed; 2. afflicted, overtaken by calamity; 3. tinged, coloured.
उपरक्ष m. A body-guard.
उपरक्षण n. A guard, an outpost.
उपरत a. (f. ता) 1. Stopped, ceased, रजस्युपरते M.v.66; 2. dead, e.g. पितर्युपरते पुत्रा विभजेयुर्धनं पितुः.
उपरत a. (f. ता) 1. Stopped, ceased, रजस्युपरते M.v.66; 2. dead, e.g. पितर्युपरते पुत्रा विभजेयुर्धनं पितुः.
उपरत-स्पृह a. indifferent to worldly belongings.
उपरति f. 1. Ceasing, stopping; 2. death; 3. indifference; 4. refraining from sexual enjoyment; 5. conviction of the futility of ceremonial acts.

उपरत्न n. A secondary or inferior gem; (उपरत्नानि काचश्च कर्पूरोऽश्मा तथैव च । मुक्ताशुक्तिस्तथा शंख इत्यादीनि बहून्यपि । गुणा यथैव रत्नानामुपरत्नेषु ते तथा । किंतु किंचित्ततो हीना विशेषोऽयमुदाहृतः Bhāvaprakāśa.)
उपर(रा)म m. 1. Ceasing, stopping; 2. abstaining from; 3. death.
उपर(रा)म m. 1. Ceasing, stopping; 2. abstaining from; 3. death.
उपरमण n. 1. Abstaining from the pleasures of sense; 2. abstaining from ceremonial acts; 3. ceasing, stopping.
उपरस m. 1. A secondary mineral; 2. a subordinate flavour.
उपराग m. 1. Colour; 2. an eclipse of the sun or moon, उपरागांते शशिनः समुपगता रोहिणू योगम् Sak.vii.; 3. calamity, affliction, injury, मृणालिनी हैममिवोपरागम् R.xvi.7; 4. reproach, blame, abuse.
उपराज m. A viceroy.

उपरि ind. As an adverb, it means- (1) high, above, upon, towards the upper side of, उपर्युपरि पश्यन्तः सर्वं एव दरिद्रति Hit.i.; (2) besides, in addition to, सहस्राण्येकविंशतिः । शतान्युपरि चैवाष्टौ तथा भूयश्च सप्ततिः Bh.; (3) afterwards, यदा पूर्वं नासीदुपरि च तथा नैव भविता Sant.S.ii.7.As a separable preposition, (with the acc. gen. or loc.), it means- (1) on, over, above, e.g. अवाङ्मुखस्योपरि पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात R.ii.60; (2) at the head, at the top, Yaj.i.819; (3) beyond, in addition to, Yaj.ii.253; (4) on, upon, in connection with, in regard to, towards, परस्परस्योपरि पर्यचीयत R.iii.24, Sant.S.xii.23; (5) after, मुहूर्तादुपरि उपाध्यायश्चेदागच्छेत्. (The double form उपर्युपरि (used either absolutely or with the acc. or gen.) means- (1) just above, e.g. उपर्युपरि लोकं हरिः, उपर्युपर्यंबुमुचां वितानैः; (2) very high, उपर्युपरि सर्वेषामादित्य इव तेजसा Bh.)
उपरि-चर a. moving above (as a bird).
उपरि-तन, -स्थ a. upper.
उपरि-तन, -स्थ a. upper.
उपरि-भाव m. the being above or higher.
उपरि-भूमि f. the ground above.

उपरिष्टात् ind. 1. As an adverb, it means- 1. over, above, Yaj.i.106; 2. further on, afterwards, कल्याणावतंसा हि कल्याणसंपदुपरिष्टाद्भवति M.M.vi.; 3. behind, (op. to पुरस्तात् in this sense.)As a preposition, (with the acc. or gen.), it means- (1) over, upon; (2) down upon; (3) behind.
उपरीतक m. A mode of sexual enjoyment. (एकपादमूरौ कृत्वा द्वितीयं स्कंधसंस्थितम् । नारीं कामयते कामी बंधः स्यादुपरीतकः.)

उपरूपक n. A drama of an inferior class of which 18 are enumerated; (they are- नाटिका, त्रोटक, गोष्ठी, सट्टक, नाट्यरासक, प्रस्थान, उल्लाप्य, काव्य, प्रेंखण, रासक, संलापक, श्रीगदित, शिल्पक, विलासिका, द्रुमेलिका, प्रकरणी, हल्लीश and भाणिका S.D.vi.)
उपरोध m. 1. Covering, surrounding, blocking, R.vi.44; 2. obstruction, impediment; 3. trouble, disturbance, तपोवननिवासिनिनामुपरोधो मा भूत् Sak.i.; 4. protection, favour.
उपरोधन n. 1. Covering, surrounding, blocking, R.vi.44; 2. obstruction, impediment; 3. trouble, disturbance, तपोवननिवासिनिनामुपरोधो मा भूत् Sak.i.; 4. protection, favour.
उपरोधक n. An inner room, a private apartment.
उपल m. 1. A rock or stone, कांते कथं घटितवानुपलेन चेतः Sr.
, Megh.i.19; 2. a precious stone, a jewel.
उपला f. 1. Refined sugar; 2. sand.
उपलक m. A stone.

उपलक्षण n. 1. Ascertainment, observation, वेलोपलक्षणार्थमादिष्टोऽस्मि Sak.iv.; 2. designation, mark; 3. the implication of something not expressed in addition to that which has been expressed, synecdoche of a part for the whole; (it is thus defined- स्वप्रतिपादकत्वे सति स्वेतरप्रतिपादकत्वम्), मंत्रग्रहणं ब्राह्मणस्याप्युपलक्षणम् S.K.
उपलब्धि f. 1. Obtaining, acquisition, gain, R.v.56, viii.17; 2. perception, knowledge, नान्जाव उपलब्धेः Bh.; 3. a guess; 4. perceptibility considered as a kind of proof by the Mīmānsākas.
उपलंभ m. 1. Acquisition, अस्मादंगुलीयोपलंभात् स्मृतिरूपलब्धा Sak.vii.; 2. comprehension otherwise than from memory, ज्ञातौ सुतस्पर्शसुखोपलंभात् R.xiv.2; 3. ascertaining.
उपालंभ m. 1. Taunt, reproach, abuse, censure, देवीं वसुमतीमंतरेण महदुपालंभनं गतोऽस्मि Sak.v.; 2. delaying.
उपलालिका f. Thirst.
उपलिंग n. A portent, a natural phenomenon considered as boding evil.
उपलिप्सा f. Desire of obtaining, Sant.S.i.12.
उपलेप m. 1. Anointing; 2. cleaning, white-washing; 3. the becoming dull of senses.
उपलेपन n. 1. Smearing, anointing; 2. an ointment, an unguent.
उपवन n. A grove, a garden, a planted forest, Megh.i.24, R.viii.73, M.ix.265, x.50.
उपवर्ण m. Minute description, detail.
उपवर्णन n. Description, delineation, अतिशयिपवर्णनं व्याख्यानम् Suśruta., Yaj.i.320.
उपवर्तन n. 1. A place for exercise; 2. a district; 3. a kingdom; 4. a bog, a marshy place.
उपावर्तन n. 1. Coming back, returning, करोति मारुतस्त्वदुपावर्तनशंकि मे मनः R.viii.53; 2. wallowing, revolving, turning round.
उपवसथ m. A village.
उपवस्त n. A fast.
उपवास m. 1. A fast, fasting, e.g. उपवासाद्वरं भिक्षा Yaj.i.175, iii.190, M.xi.195; 2. kindling a sacred fire.
उपवाहन n. Carrying to, bringing near.
उपवाह्य m. 1. A king’s elephant; 2. any royal vehicle.
उपविद्या f. Profane science, inferor sort of knowledge.
उपविष m. 1. A deleterious drug (they are- अर्कक्षीरं स्नुहीक्षीरं तथैव कलिहारिका । धत्तूरः करवीरश्च पंच चोपविषाः स्मृताः); 2. factitious poison.
उपवीत n. 1. Investiture with the sacred thread; 2. the thread worn by the first three castes of the Hindus, पित्र्यमंशमुपवीतलक्षणं मातृकं च धनुरूर्जितं दधत् R.xi.64, M.ii.44, 64.
उपवृंहण n. Increase, collection.

उपवेद m. A class of writings subordinate to the Vedas. (They are four, one उपवेद being attached to each of the four Vedas. Thus आयुर्वेद is attached to ऋग्वेद, धनुर्वेद to यजुर्वेद, गांधर्ववेद to सामवेद, and शस्त्रशास्त्र to अथर्ववेद; according to Suśruta and the Bhāvaprakāśa, however, आयुर्वेद is attached not to the ऋग्वेद but to the अथर्ववेद.)
उपवेश m. 1. Sitting down; 2. being attached to; 3. voiding by stool.
उपवेशन n. 1. Sitting down; 2. being attached to; 3. voiding by stool.
उपवैणव n. The three periods of the day, morning, midday and evening.
उपव्याख्यान n. A supplementary explanation or interpretation.
उपव्याघ्र m. A small hunting leopard.
उपशम m. 1. The becoming quiet, assuagement, cessation, extinction, कृतोऽस्या उपशमः Ve.iii., मन्युर्दुःसह एष यात्युपशमं नो सांत्ववादैः स्फुटम् Am.
; 2. calmness, patience, quietude; 3. control over the senses.
उपशमन n. 1. Quieting, calming; 2. extinction, cessation.
उपशय m. Lying by the side of.
उपशाय m. Sleeping in turn or rotation of those who keep watch at night.
उपशल्य n. An open place in the vicinity of a town or village, R.xv.60, xvi.37.
उपशाखा f. A secondary branch.
उपशांति f. The same as उपशम q.v., R.viii.31, Am.
उपशाल n. A place near a house, a court before a house.
उपशिक्षण n. Learning, training.
उपशिक्षा f. Learning, training.
उपशिष्य m. The pupil of a pupil, स्वतः प्रमाणं परतः प्रमाणं शुकांगना यत्र समुद्गिरंति । शिष्योपशिष्यैरुपगीयमानमवेहि तन्मंडनमिश्रधाम Ud.
उपशोभन n. Adorning, ornamenting.
उपशोभा f. Adorning, ornamenting.
उपशोषण m. Drying up.

उपश्रुति f. 1. Giving ear to; 2. range of hearing; 3. a supernatural voice heard at night and personified as a nocturnal deity revealing the future (the Hārāvalī says- नक्तं निर्गत्य यत्किंचिच्छुभाशुभकरं वचः । श्रूयते तद्विदुर्धीरा देवप्रश्ननुपश्रुतिम्), परिजनोऽपि चास्याः सततमुपश्रुत्यै निर्जगाम Kad.; 4. promise, assent.
उपश्लेष m. 1. Juxtaposition, contact; 2. an embrace.
उपश्लेषण n. 1. Juxtaposition, contact; 2. an embrace.
उपसंयम m. 1. Curbing, restraining, binding; 2. the end of the world.
उपसंयोग m. A secondary connection, a modification.
उपसंरोह m. Growing together.
उपसंवाद m. An agreement, a contract.
उपसंव्यान n. An undergarment.
उपसंहरण n. 1. Withdrawing; 2. withholding; 3. attacking, invading.

उपसंहार m. 1. Drawing in or together; 2. withdrawing; 3. attacking, invading; 4. collection, assemblage; 5. summing up, a résumé; 6. death; 7. conclusion, e.g. उपक्रमोपसंहारौ हेतुस्तात्पर्यनिर्णये; 8. a peroration.
उपसंहारिन् m. A hetu which is not अनुपसंहारिन् q.v.
उपसंक्षेप m. A summary, an abstract, a résumé.

उपसंख्यान n. 1. Addition; 2. further enumeration (this word is technically applied to the vārtikas written by Kātyāyana to supply the defects of Pāṇini’s sūtras. See Mall. on Sis.ii.112. Cf. इष्टि); 3. a substitute in form or sense (in gram.).

उपसंग्रह m. 1. Respectful salutation by touching the feet of the person saluted, स्फुरति रमसात्पाणिः पादोपसंग्रहणाय च Mv.ii.; 2. polite address; 3. collecting, joining; 4. taking, accepting (as wife), Yaj.i.56; 5. an appendage, a necessary article of use or decoration.

उपसंग्रहण n. 1. Respectful salutation by touching the feet of the person saluted, स्फुरति रमसात्पाणिः पादोपसंग्रहणाय च Mv.ii.; 2. polite address; 3. collecting, joining; 4. taking, accepting (as wife), Yaj.i.56; 5. an appendage, a necessary article of use or decoration.
उपसत्ति f. 1. Connection, union; 2. service, worship; 3. gift, donation.
उपसद m. 1. Approach; 2. gift, donation.
उपसदन n. 1. Becoming a pupil, तत्रोपसदनं चक्रे द्रोणस्येष्वस्त्रकर्मणि Bh.; 2. going near to; 3. neighbourhood.
उपसंतान m. 1. Immediate connection; 2. a descendant.
उपसंन्यास m. Laying down, giving up.
उपसमाधान n. Gathering together, heaping (उपसमाधानं राशीकरणम् S.K.)
उपसंपन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) Killed at a sacrifice (as an animal).
उपसंपन्न (II) n. Condiment.
उपसंपन्न (I) a. (f. न्ना) Killed at a sacrifice (as an animal).
उपसंभाषा f. Friendly persuasion. (उपसंभाषा उपसांत्वनम् S.K.)
उपसर m. 1. Approaching; 2. pregnancy, the first pregnancy of a cow (गवामुपसरः S.K.).
उपसरण n. 1. Going towards; 2. what is approached as a refuge.

उपसर्ग m. 1. Ailment, sickness, क्षीणां हन्युश्चोपसर्गाः प्रभूताः Suśruta; 2. injury, misfortune; 3. portent, natural phenomenon foreboding evil; 4. an eclipse; 5. an indication or symptom of death; 6. an inseparable preposition prefixed to roots (thus defined- प्रादयस्तूपसर्गकाः । द्योतकत्वात्क्रियायोगे लोकादवगता इमे.) उपसर्ग are twenty-two in number- प्र, परा, अप, सम्, अनु, अव, निस्, निर्, दुस्, दुर्, वि, आङ्, नि, अधि, अपि, अति, सु, उत्, अभि, प्रति, परि, उप; according to one theory they are meaningless themselves, and simply bring to light the hidden sense of roots when prefixed to them (द्योतकतानय); according to another they are significant by themselves (वाचकतानय). They modify or sometimes entirely alter the sense of the root; (उपसर्गेण धात्वर्थो बलादन्यत्र नीयते । प्रहाराहारसंहारविहारपरिहारवत् S.K.)

उपसर्जन n. 1. Pouring on; 2. misfortune, calamity; 3. a portent; 4. any person or thing subordinate to another; 5. a word which by composition or derivation loses its original independence while it also determines the sense of another word (in gram.).
उपसर्प m. Approach, access.
उपसर्पण n. Going near, approaching, advancing towards.
उपसर्या f. A cow fit for a bull.
उपसूर्यक n. The solar halo.
उपसृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Joined, connected with, accompanied by; 2. troubled, affected, injured, R.viii.94; 3. furnished with an उपसर्ग (as a root), क्रुधद्रुहोरुपसृष्टयोः कर्म Pan.; 4. eclipsed.
उपसृष्ट (II) m. 1. The sun or moon in eclipse; 2. a libidinous man, उपसृष्टा इव क्षुद्राधिष्ठितभवनाः Kad.
उपसृष्ट (III) n. Copulation, coition.
उपसृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Joined, connected with, accompanied by; 2. troubled, affected, injured, R.viii.94; 3. furnished with an उपसर्ग (as a root), क्रुधद्रुहोरुपसृष्टयोः कर्म Pan.; 4. eclipsed.
उपसेचन n. 1. Pouring or sprinkling upon, watering; 2. infusion.
उपसेवन n. 1. Worshipping, honouring; 2. service; 3. using, enjoying, M.iv.134.
उपसेवा f. 1. Service; 2. worship, honour.

उपस्कर m. 1. Any article which serves to make complete, an ingredient; 2. condiment; 3. furniture, appurtenance, apparatus, such as a broom-stick, &c., M.iii.68, xii.66, Yaj.ii.193; 4. an article of household use; 5. an ornament; 6. blame, censure.
उपस्कार m. 1. Beautifying, ornamenting, Mall. on R.xi.48; 2. an ornament; 3. a collection; 4. a supplement, any thing additional; 5. an ellipsis, साकांक्षमनुपस्कारं विष्वग्गति निराकुलम् Kir.xi.38.
उपस्करण n. 1. Killing, injuring; 2. ornament; 3. a collection; 4. change, modification; 5. an ellipsis.
उपस्कृत a. (f. ता) 1. Adorned; 2. modified; 3. collected, (pp. of कृ with उप q.v.)
उपस्कृत a. (f. ता) 1. Adorned; 2. modified; 3. collected, (pp. of कृ with उप q.v.)
उपस्तंभ m. 1. Stay, support; 2. encouragement, incitement; 3. basis, ground.
उपस्तंभन n. 1. Stay, support; 2. encouragement, incitement; 3. basis, ground.
उपस्तरण n. 1. A covering; 2. a bed; 3. anything spread out, e.g. अमृतोपस्तरणमसि.
उपस्त्री f. A concubine.
उपस्थ (I) m. 1. The lap; 2. middle part in general.

उपस्थ (II) m.n. 1. The male organ of generation, स्नानं मौनोपवासेज्या स्वाध्यायोपस्थनिग्रहाः Yaj.iii.314; 2. the female organ of generation, स्थूलोपस्थस्थलीषु Bhartr.i.20 (in Yaj.iii.92, the word is used in senses 1 and 2); 3. the anus; 4. the haunch or hip.
उपस्थ-निग्रह m. continence, Yaj.iii.314.
उपस्थ-दल, -पत्र m. the Indian fig tree (the tree is so called because its leaves resemble in shape the female organ of generation.)
उपस्थ-दल, -पत्र m. the Indian fig tree (the tree is so called because its leaves resemble in shape the female organ of generation.)

उपस्थान n. 1. Proximity, nearness; 2. approaching, coming into the presence of; 3. worshipping, waiting, waiting upon with a prayer, obeisance, सूर्योपस्थाने विनियोगः Sandhyāprayoga., सूर्योपस्थानात्प्रतिनिवृत्तं पुरूरवसं मामुपेत्य Vikr.i., उदयोन्मुखस्य भगवतः सूर्यस्योपस्थानं कुर्वः iv.; 4. a sanctuary; 5. remembrance, recollection, memory, Yaj.iii.160.
उपस्थापन n. 1. Placing near; 2. the awakening of memory; 3. attendance, service.
उपस्थायक m. A servant.
उपस्थिति f. 1. Approach, presence; 2. obtaining, getting; 3. accomplishing; 4. remembrance, recollection; 5. service, attendance.
उपस्पर्श m. 1. Touching, contact; 2. bathing, ablution; 3. rinsing the mouth, sipping water as a religious act.
उपस्पर्शन n. 1. Touching, contact; 2. bathing, ablution; 3. rinsing the mouth, sipping water as a religious act.
उपस्मृति f. A minor law-book. (Cf. स्मृति)
उपस्रवण n. The periodical flow of a woman.
उपस्वत्व n. Revenue, profit.

उपहत a. (f. ता) 1. Censured, rebuked, disregarded; 2. impure; 3. doomed, destroyed, e.g. दैवेनोपहतस्य वृद्धिरथवा पूर्वं विपर्यस्यति; 4. hurt, injured; 5. vitiated, polluted, शारीरैर्मलैः सुराभिर्मद्यैर्वा यदुपहतं तदत्यन्तोपहतम् Viṣṇu.

उपहत a. (f. ता) 1. Censured, rebuked, disregarded; 2. impure; 3. doomed, destroyed, e.g. दैवेनोपहतस्य वृद्धिरथवा पूर्वं विपर्यस्यति; 4. hurt, injured; 5. vitiated, polluted, शारीरैर्मलैः सुराभिर्मद्यैर्वा यदुपहतं तदत्यन्तोपहतम् Viṣṇu.
उपहत-आत्मन् a. agitated in mind, mentally affected.
उपहत-दृश् a. dazzled, blinded, Kir.xii.18.
उपहत-धी a. infatuated.
उपहतक a. (f. का) Ill-fated, unfortunate.
उपहतक a. (f. का) Ill-fated, unfortunate.
उपहत्या f. Dazzling of the eyes.
उपहरण n. 1. Bringing near; 2. offering gifts to superiors; 3. presenting victims; 4. serving out food.
उपहसित n. Satirical laughter.
उपहस्तिका f. A small box containing condiments or betel, उपहस्तिकायास्तांबूलं कर्पूरसहितमुद्धृत्य मह्यं दत्वा D.K.
उपहार m. 1. Oblation; 2. a present to a superior; 3. an offering to a deity; 4. honour; 5. indemnification; 6. food distributed to guests.
उपाहार m. Slight refreshment.
उपहार m. 1. Oblation; 2. a present to a superior; 3. an offering to a deity; 4. honour; 5. indemnification; 6. food distributed to guests.
उपहालक m. A name of the Kuntala country.
उपहास m. 1. Fun, play; 2. ridicule, R.xii.37; 3. satirical laughter.
उपहासक m. A jester.
उपहित a. (f. ता) Placed, put, (pp. of धा with उप q.v.)
उपहित a. (f. ता) Placed, put, (pp. of धा with उप q.v.)
उपाहित (I) a. (f. ता) Connected.
उपाहित (II) m. Danger or destruction from fire.
उपाहित (I) a. (f. ता) Connected.
उपहूति f. Calling, calling out, inviting.
उपह्वर n. 1. Proximity; 2. solitary or private place, उपह्वरे पुनरित्यशिक्षयं भनमित्रम् D.K.
उपह्वान n. 1. Inviting; 2. inviting with prayers.
उपांशु (I) ind. 1. In a whisper; 2. secretly, in secret, privately, परिचेतुमुपांशु धीरणाम् R.viii.18.
उपांशु (II) m. A prayer uttered in a low voice; (See M.ii.85 and Kulluka on it.)
उपाकर्मन् n. 1. Preparation, beginning, commencement; 2. a ceremony performed before commencing to read the Veda after the monsoons, Yaj.i.142 (in. ritualistic works).
उपाकृत a. (f. ता) Killed at a sacrifice (as an animal).
उपाकृत a. (f. ता) Killed at a sacrifice (as an animal).
उपाक्षम् ind. Before the eyes, in presence of.
उपाख्यान n. A short tale, a short narrative, उपाख्यानैर्विना तावद् भारतं प्रोच्यते बुधैः Bh.
उपाख्यान n. A short tale, a short narrative, उपाख्यानैर्विना तावद् भारतं प्रोच्यते बुधैः Bh.
उपाग्र n. The part which is next to the end or top.
उपांग n. 1. A subdivision; 2. any minor limb or member; 3. a supplement of a supplement; 4. a class of work supplementary to the Vedāṅgas. (पौराणन्यायमीमांसाधर्मशास्त्राणि चत्वार्युपांगानि.)
उपाजे ind. (used only with the root कृ) Supporting, infusing vigour (it considered as a prefix or not; hence उपाजेकृत्य or उपाजे कृत्वा. Cf. अन्वाजे.)
उपांजन n. Anointing, plastering the ground with cow-dung, M.v.105 (Medhātithi explains the word by मठादेः सुधागोमयादिना संमार्जनानुलेपने.
उपात्यय m. Transgression, deviation.
उपादान-कारण n. a material cause, पारिशेष्याद् ब्रह्मणोऽन्यदुपादानकारणमशुद्धद्याधिगुणकं स्मृतिप्रसिद्धमभ्युपगंतव्यम् S.Bh.i.
उपादान-लक्षणा f. the same as अजहत्स्वार्था q.v., K.Pr.ii., S.D.ii.

उपाध्याय m. 1. A teacher in general; 2. a spiritual teacher, a religious preceptor, किं भवानस्मदुपाध्यायादपि धर्मवित्तरः Mud.i. An उपाध्याय instructs for wages. (एकदेशं ति वेदस्य वेदांगान्यपि वा पुनः । योऽध्यापयति वृत्त्यर्थमुपाध्यायः स उच्यते M.ii.141). See अध्यापक and आचार्य.
उपाध्याया f. A female preceptor.
उपाध्यायानी f. The wife of a preceptor.
उपाध्यायी f. 1. A female preceptor; 2. the wife of a preceptor.

, K.S.vii.32; 8. side, slope, Megh.i.18; 4. the angle of the eye.
उपांतिक (I) m. (fem. की) Near, proximate, neighbouring.
उपांतिक (II) n. Vicinity, proximity.
उपांत्य (I) a. (f. त्या) Last but one.
उपांत्य (II) m. The corner of the eye.
उपांत्य (III) n. Vicinity.
उपांत्य (I) a. (f. त्या) Last but one.
उपाय m. 1. Approach; 2. a means, an expedient, a remedy, Am.

, M.viii.48; 3. beginning, commencement; 4. effort, exertion, Bg.vi.36; 5. a way, a mode, M.ix.248, x.2; 6. any of the four means of success against an enemy (in civil polity) चतुर्थोपायसाध्ये तु रिपौ सांत्वमपक्रिया Sis.ii.54, सामादीनामुपायानां चतुर्णामपि पंडिताः M.viii.109.

उपाय-चतुष्टय n. the four expedients against an enemy, viz, साम, दान, भेद and दंड. (According to some authorities, these expendients are seven in number. They add माया, उपेक्षा, and इंद्रजाल to the four already mentioned.)
उपाय-तुरीय m. the fourth means, that is, punishment.
उपाय-योग m. application of means or remedy, M.ix.10.
उपारंभ m. Beginning, commencement, e.g. सर्वकर्मोपारंभे विनियोगः.
उपार्जन n. Acquiring, gaining, अर्थस्योपार्जनम् Panch.ii.
उपालंभन n. 1. Taunt, reproach, abuse, censure, देवीं वसुमतीमंतरेण महदुपालंभनं गतोऽस्मि Sak.v.; 2. delaying.
उपाश्रय m. 1. Recourse, asylum, support; 2. reliance.
उपासक m. 1. A servant; 2. worshipper, a follower; 3. a Śūdra.
उपासंग m. 1. Proximity; 2. a quiver.
उपासन n. 1. Engaging in, performing, M.ii.69; 2. practice of archery; 3. service, attendance, waiting upon, M.iii.107, Na.i.34, Bg.xiii.7, Yaj.iii.156; 4. worship, adoration; 5. religious meditation.
उपासना f. 1. Engaging in, performing, M.ii.69; 2. practice of archery; 3. service, attendance, waiting upon, M.iii.107, Na.i.34, Bg.xiii.7, Yaj.iii.156; 4. worship, adoption; 5. religious meditation.
उपासा f. 1. Religious reflection; 2. service, attendance; 3. worship.
उपास्तमन n. Sunset.
उपास्ति f. 1. Service, attendance; 2. worship.
